_comment: W28 canonical all-position training check on the established 6% user sample.
Architecture and optimization match the frozen SASRec v1 BCE cell; only
the training objective changes from copied final-position prefixes to one
causal encoder pass per bounded sequence window with every eligible target.
2026-10-05 (WO-1): training_objective written out when SASRecConfig gained the
field and its default returned to the objective of record. The run is unchanged;
without this line, re-running the file would train the copied-prefix objective.
